newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Camelot takes control of Northern G..
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Camelot takes control of Northern G..

text.p: Camelot Resources NL said on Tuesday it had increased its stake in Northern Gold NL to 56.0 percent following the purchase of 19.08 million shares in the company from Golden Valley Mines NL.

Camelot said its purchase was based on a pre-emptive rights agreement with Golden Valley which was approved by Northern Gold shareholders in February. It said the shares were acquired at an effective price of 32.7 cents per share.
Northern Gold ended two cents higher at 30 cents and topped the local turnover list with 19.18 million shares traded.
It has 66.67 million shares on issue.
Northern Gold is exploring the Pine Creek properties in the Northern Territory and said recently it had total estimated resources of 1.127 million ounces of gold.
